video.title: What is Cloud Computing? ☁️ | How to Learn Cloud | What is Cloud Engineer Salary

transcript.text: What is cloud computing and why is it so
popular today? Let me explain you this.
Cloud computing is nothing but delivery
of IT services like server, databases,
storage, machine learning and much more.
Everything that is necessary for a
company or a startup to build their
applications online and in a
pay-as-you-go model, which means you
don't have to pay a fixed amount and you
pay only for what you use in the cloud.
Companies like Netflix, Snapchat,
LinkedIn, BMW and Twitter are all in the
cloud. Currently, there are so many
cloud jobs today because every company
wants to move their architecture to the
cloud. According to indeed.com, a cloud
engineer in United States can earn up to
which is one of the highest-paying jobs
in tech. If you want to learn cloud, let
me help you. Subscribe to my channel
where I post videos on AWS cloud,
DevOps, which can help you get your
cloud job today.
